home_lede: Rampsmith finds WCAG 2.2 AA failures in your Shopify store and fixes them in your own data and theme code, with a dated record of every change.
home_note: Automated checks find many accessibility issues, not all of them. Rampsmith tells you what it checked and what still needs a person.
embedded_failed: Rampsmith could not reach your store. Reload the app to try again.
embedded_next_body: Scans, findings and fixes arrive in the next release. Your store's access is set up and kept current.
error_body: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, contact support and quote reference {reference}.
dash_empty: Your sites and agency stores will appear here.
signin_lede: Use the passkey saved on this device or in your password manager.
signin_failed: Sign-in did not complete. Try again, or create an account if you do not have one.
register_lede: Your account is protected by a passkey instead of a password.
register_failed: The account could not be created. {reason}
passkeys_unsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys. Use an up-to-date browser to continue.
passkeys_need_js: Passkeys need JavaScript. Turn it on to sign in.
app_announce_approved: Approved the alt text for {product}. It is being applied to your store.
app_announce_edited: Saved your edit to the alt text for {product}.
app_announce_undone: Undid the alt text change for {product}. The earlier text is back.
app_applied_empty: Nothing has been applied yet. Approved alt text appears here, where you can undo it.
app_checks_caveat: Automated checks find many accessibility issues, not all of them. What they cannot decide needs a person.
app_criterion_learn: Understanding success criterion {id} (opens in a new tab)
app_edit_empty: Write some alt text, or reject this suggestion.
app_edit_too_long: Alt text can be at most {max} characters.
app_error_conflict: This changed while you were working. Reload and try again.
app_error_forbidden: Your plan or role does not allow this.
app_error_network: Rampsmith could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
app_error_rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
app_error_unauthenticated: Your session expired. Reload the app to sign in again.
app_error_unavailable: Rampsmith is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
app_error_validation: Some of the values are not valid. Check them and try again.
app_evidence_after_alt: Screenshot of the element after the fix
app_evidence_before_alt: Screenshot of the element before the fix
app_feature_prs_body: Rampsmith can open a pull request with a theme code fix for you to review and merge.
app_feature_rewrites_body: Rampsmith can suggest clearer product descriptions for your review.
app_finding_no_evidence: No before and after evidence has been captured yet.
app_finding_no_fix: There is no fix for this issue yet.
app_finding_no_occurrences: No occurrences are recorded for this issue.
app_findings_empty_body: Run a scan to check your store, or come back after the next scheduled scan.
app_findings_table_caption: Open accessibility issues, most important first
app_fix_failed: This change could not be applied. Nothing on your store was changed.
app_fix_has_text: The image contains text. Check that the alt text repeats it.
app_log_caption: Every change Rampsmith made or proposed, with who approved it and how it was verified
app_log_empty_body: Changes appear here once Rampsmith proposes them.
app_log_export_body: Download the log as a spreadsheet or as data, to keep with your accessibility records.
app_log_export_failed: The log could not be downloaded.
app_overview_empty_body: Run your first scan to see which accessibility issues your store has.
app_plan_drafts: AI alt text drafts this period: {used} of {limit}
app_queue_empty: Nothing is waiting for review. New alt text suggestions appear here after a scan.
app_scan_failed_body: The last scan did not finish. Nothing on your store was changed. Try again.
app_scan_partial_body: Some pages could not be checked, so these results are incomplete.
app_scan_start_failed: The scan could not be started.
app_scan_started: Scan started. Results appear here as pages are checked.
app_settings_budget_hint: Rampsmith stops drafting when the budget is used. Your plan allows up to {max}.
app_settings_chars_hint: Short alt text is easier to listen to. 150 is a good limit.
app_settings_email_hint: Rampsmith writes here about scan results and fixes waiting for you.
app_settings_password_hint: Only if your store is password protected. Rampsmith stores it encrypted and uses it only to scan.
app_settings_password_saved: A password is saved. Enter a new one to replace it.
app_settings_weekly_hint: Rampsmith checks your store once a week and tells you if something new breaks.
app_settings_weekly_locked: Weekly rescans are part of paid plans.
app_statement_compatibility: Browsers and assistive technology you have tested with
app_statement_contact_hint: Tell visitors how to report a barrier. Give at least one way to reach you.
app_statement_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
app_statement_intro: Write the statement for your store. Rampsmith adds what it found in its scans and what it did not check, so the statement stays accurate.
app_statement_limitations_hint: Add barriers you know about that the scans cannot find. Leave this empty if there are none.
app_statement_measures_hint: One measure per line, such as "We test new pages with a screen reader".
app_statement_no_versions: No version has been saved yet.
app_statement_review_note: This statement is a draft for you to review. Have it checked by someone qualified before you publish it. Attorney review required.
app_statement_save_failed: The statement could not be saved.
app_statement_status_no_known_barriers: The latest automated checks found no barriers. This does not mean the whole site meets the standard.
app_statement_status_not_evaluated: Not evaluated yet. Run a scan first.
app_statement_preview_incomplete: The preview appears once the contact details and the other entries are filled in correctly. Add at least one way to contact you.
